linkedin.headline: Ecologist | Marshlight Conservation Trust
linkedin.about: I survey wetland birds and advise on habitat management. I am gentle, patient and calm, and I work best outdoors. I love birdwatching, photography and long hikes at dawn. I need quiet time to recharge, and I am looking for someone who listens first and enjoys nature.

experience.title: Ecologist
experience.description: Run bird surveys and write management plans for wetlands.

instagram.bio: Early birds, early starts. Quietly happy outdoors.
